historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' issuance of a permit to alter the building at 969 Wisconsin Street.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 969 Wisconsin Street, affirming that the appellant's recourse is to seek a variance.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' issuance of a permit to alter the building at 969 Wisconsin Street, with a stipulation that the room in question be built according to code, in conformance with approved plans.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' revocation of an electrical permit for the property at 969 Wisconsin Street, with the understanding that the appellant will reapply for a permit.
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of an electrical permit for work at 969 Wisconsin Street, allowing the work to proceed.
